- ↗ **Open** — opens the file with the OS def"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ault application (via the harness's built-in `host.openPath` RPC).

That's it — no configuration required."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Remove with:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Gesture | Result |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Agent creates/downloads a file | Panel pops up automatically (newest files carry a `NEW` chip) |
|"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" Click a row | Inline preview (image / text / metadata) |
| Row hover actions | Preview, open, show "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"in folder, copy path |

frame-wide floating layer"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"), reads the current session through the standard

The channel is registered with `ctx.connection.rpc.handle`, the sanctioned
s"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"tatic-package RPC seam."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Security"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- The `/file-panel` channel is registered with `authority: 'loopback'`, so

over the network (`--trusted-host`), the panel shows"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" a notice and stays
inactive.
- Every read/reveal endpoint only accepts absolute paths that the trac"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ker
has actually seen (a tool write or a watcher event under a watched working
directory) — the RPC "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"can never be used as a generic file-read/reveal
primitive."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Project layout"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"For a fast client-side iteration loop after changing `src/client.jsx`:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"then hard-refresh the GUI page (`lib/client.js` is served with

to rebuil"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"d client bundles on change."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Built against the public seams of `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.x`:"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- host: `ctx.connection.rpc.handle` / `ctx.on('fs/observed')`
